title: centaurea nigra subsp. nevadensis
intro: Centaurea nigra subsp. nevadensis, commonly known as Nevada knapweed, is a plant species within the daisy family (Asteraceae) and is native to the Iberian Peninsula, France, and the western Mediterranean. It is valued for its medicinal properties, offering relief from various health issues. The health benefits of Nevada knapweed include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in soothing digestive issues and promoting wound healing. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones and phenolic acids, which may exhibit antioxidant and antiproliferative effects.
